notes.title: Major progression fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed major issue, where if the interact button is quickly spammed when opening a locked door, two keys could be consumed, likely breaking dungeon progression.
 - Fixed duplicate key glitch in dungeon 8.
 - Fixed progression break in dungeon 7, due to doorway collision issues.
 - Fixed a glitch associated with the Kobold Tech Rune (teleportation rune), where it would not function whilst the Companion Pet is active. This fixes progression issues in multiple dungeons.

More miscellaneous dungeon and puzzle related patches to come, as we gather feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: We have a Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have a release date for Airoheart! It'll come out on [b]September 30, 2022[/b], so If you haven't already make sure to add the game to your Steam wishlist and follow for news! ALSO, we have a brand new gameplay trailer, go check that out! [previewyoutube=TDsa3bCVAdU;full][/previewyoutube]
So as you may have seen, the game is also coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S so if that's your jam, make sure to check those digital store pages or check with your local retailer/regional Amazon for a PHYSICAL copy 🙌

For now that's all, but of course from now until September we'll unveil more about Airoheart. See ya then!

-Marten

notes.title: ⚔ Welcome to the Airoheart Steam page ⚔
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the Airoheart Steam page, I'm really glad to have you here! My name is Marten, Community Manager at SOEDESCO, the publisher of Airoheart. Over the coming time we'll keep sharing more news, info, footage and screenshots right here on the Community Hub! Currently we are running a closed beta test for select Kickstarter backers and a few other participants, there's a lot of feedback coming in which we're very happy with!

In the meantime, you can join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/soedesco, you can talk to us directly there and the developer, Samuel as well!

Oh and of course, if you haven't checked out the Airoheart trailer yet, watch it here: [previewyoutube=DtmKgeYO1cY;full][/previewyoutube]
See you next time!

-Marten
